title: Doubled word at a position
statement: For Boolean words $x,u$ and a natural number $q$, say that $u$ is doubled at position $q$ in $x$ if, for every $i<|u|$, the entries of $x$ at positions $q+2i$ and $q+2i+1$ both equal the entry of $u$ at position $i$. The entries of $x$ at positions $q+2|u|$ and $q+2|u|+1$ must respectively be false and true; any out-of-range list lookup is interpreted as false.
